unmodeled_or_independently_tested_dimens: Formal models use the smallest two-file witness domain; product E2E covers mux generations through generation 4 but not exhaustive three-file states.
Filesystem write failures and external notification-command failures are not modeled.
Network disconnect/reconnect delivery loss beyond exact retry is not modeled.
Share-token authorization is not formalized and is covered by product share read-only E2E.
The existing 25000 ms heartbeat fanout is source-audited for all mux clients but is not held open for a 25-second wall-clock E2E.

Review session identity (repo, branch, mode, ordered files) and cwd CLI session resolution are product persistence boundaries; they are not in the Lean/Alloy/Quint two-file delivery model and are covered by review_session_isolation.ts, review_session_cli_resolution.ts, and headed Chrome screenshots.
